name: ww-w-slide-gen
description: Build presentations as editable HTML slides: one claim per slide, brand tokens, generated art with editable text on top, one self-contained deck.html.

interface.shortDescription: Editable HTML decks from your story.
interface.longDescription: Give it a brief, notes or a document. It outlines one claim per slide, copies the deck template, applies your brand tokens, writes each slide in editable HTML, generates art without baked text when needed, builds one self-contained deck.html and checks every slide.
defaultPrompt: Make a 10-slide pitch deck from these notes.
Turn this proposal document into a company intro deck.
